title: writing-gate rules file
description: Format of the shared packs (shared/skills/writing-gate/packs/<lang>.json) and of the optional project pack <project>/project-context/voice/rules.json. A project pack may hold only banned_words, or add rules, disable shared codes, or change their level.

pack.description: Pack name, for example en or fr.

language.description: Language the rules apply to. A project pack defaults to any.

banned_words.description: Words or phrases the founder never wants in copy. Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, always BLOCK (code banned-word).

disable.description: Shared rule codes switched off for this project (for example after calibration on the founder's own texts).

levels.description: Level override per shared rule code.

family.description: Tic family, for example two-step-correction, hollow-intensifier, staging, trailing-participle, grandiosity, dash, object-as-agent.

pattern.description: Python regular expression, applied to the text with blank lines kept as paragraph breaks. Avoid crossing paragraphs: use [^\n] instead of '.' with DOTALL.

flags.description: i: ignore case, m: multiline (^ and $ per line), x: verbose.

escalate_at.description: A WARN rule whose hit count in one text reaches this number turns every hit into BLOCK.

message.description: How to fix it, in one sentence, in the imperative.

bad.description: Examples that must trigger the rule (tested by tests/run_tests.py).

good.description: Near-misses that must not trigger the rule.
